idea.idea_text: An AI-powered healthcare platform that helps patients manage chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension. The platform connects wearable devices, electronic health records, and mobile applications to continuously monitor vital signs. It provides personalized health recommendations, medication reminders, early risk detection, and allows doctors to remotely monitor patient health. The goal is to reduce hospital visits, improve treatment adherence, and provide affordable preventive healthcare for both urban and rural communities.
